name: Voxtell Chat
description:
Voxtell Chat is the shared inbox for Voxtell customers: website chat, email, WhatsApp, and SMS conversations in one place, with contacts, labels, canned responses, reports, and a help center.

This connector lets Claude work in that inbox with you. Ask what is open, read a thread and get the gist, draft a reply and post it as a private note or send it, set status and priority, assign a conversation to a teammate, find a contact by name or email, and pull team and inbox reports. Administrators can also manage help center articles.

You sign in with your normal Voxtell Chat email and password on a Voxtell page; Claude never sees your password and only receives a revocable connection. Every tool is labelled read or write, so Claude asks before anything changes. There are no delete tools. Voxtell does not use your conversations to train AI models.

Requires a Voxtell Chat account. Learn more at https://voxtell.com/integrations/mcp.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Voxtell Chat to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Voxtell Chat to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://chat-mcp.voxtell.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Voxtell Chat MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Voxtell Chat lists 36 MCP tools, including assign_conversation, create_article, create_canned_response, create_contact, filter_contacts, filter_conversations, get_agent_summary, get_channel_summary, get_contact, get_contact_conversations, get_conversation, and get_conversation_counts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Voxtell Chat?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Voxtell Chat in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Voxtell Chat MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Voxtell Chat requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Voxtell Chat is developed by Voxtell. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
